\section[pūntōṭṭaṁ]{\ml{പൂന്തോട്ടം} (pūntōṭṭaṁ) — a garden}

\label{lesson:ML-C149-puntottam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for an island, then the Malayalam for a shore.

Does \emph{vaikunnēraṁ} mean afternoon or evening? (A dictionary lists both; phrasebooks use it for evening.)
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പൂന്തോട്ടം}}
\textbf{\ml{പൂന്തോട്ടം}} — \emph{pūntōṭṭaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}a garden\textquotedblright{}.
